verdict.rationale: The Gusto CLI explicitly supports a documented '--env sandbox (api.gusto-demo.com)' credential slot separate from production, letting agentic users test flows (payroll prep, timesheets, dry-runs) against sandbox data without touching production, and demo companies are auto-generated for embedded partners to test with pre-populated data instead of live records. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on third-party confirmation that the sandbox environment behaves identically to production or fully isolates data, and no explicit mention of sandbox mode in the embedded-payroll API docs themselves (only in the CLI evidence).
